description: Earth's slant paths for R08.T4.d's end-to-end test (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md, its tests), written by apps/hyperion/src/renderer/src/view/atmosphere/absorbers/earthLines.test.ts under a bless: the US Standard Atmosphere 1976's troposphere to its tropopause on Design note 3's column, O2 well mixed and AFGL's 1.42 g cm-2 of water to 300 hPa, in 80 layers equal in ln p from each start height to 1 Pa. Each layer: its O2-weighted pressure (Pa) and temperature (K), O2's and H2O's mole fractions, and each path's O2 and H2O columns (m-2) and H2O's continuum pair columns (m-5), in zenithDeg's order. src/tools/lineReferences.ts reads it to take the paths line by line.
